_comment: IBM year-end market capitalization in US$ MILLIONS. 2001-2016: IBM's own disclosed 'Market capitalization' line from each report's Financial Highlights / Selected Financial Data table (primary source, cross-validated). 1984-2000 and 2017-2025: external market data sourced from Yahoo Finance / stockanalysis.com (Dec 31 year-end values) and companiesmarketcap.com / wallstreetnumbers.com (1984-1995).
